parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activities against human Beta-secretase 1 (CHEMBL4822). Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and require both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi) to be present. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
